LESSON: VIRTUES IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Virtues in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Virtues in Islam. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important for Muslims to practise virtues?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
2. describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
3. practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
4. value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: VIRTUES IN ISLAM
This lesson teaches Virtues in Islam for Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Virtues in Islam using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Virtues in Islam above.
2. Explain Virtues in Islam to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Virtues in Islam.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Virtues in Islam with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Virtues in Islam important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important for Muslims to practise virtues?
2. How can a Muslim student exercise contentment in his life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain Islamic teachings on observing modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s commandments
2. describe ways in which Muslims can practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness as part of faith
3. practise modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness in day-to-day life to earn rewards from Allah (S.W.T.)
4. value modesty, contentment, and trustworthiness for a morally upright society

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
